definitions.explanation: The activity of climbing or hiking up mountains for recreation or sport.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{山登|やまのぼ}りに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going mountain climbing this weekend.

examples.japanese: {山登|やまのぼ}りが{趣味|しゅみ}です。
{山登|やまのぼ}り{用|よう}の{靴|くつ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought shoes for mountain climbing.

notes:
COMPOUND: {山|やま} (mountain) + {登|のぼ}り (climbing)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {山登|やまのぼ}りに{行|い}く (go mountain climbing)
- {山登|やまのぼ}りをする (do mountain climbing)
- {山登|やまのぼ}り{用|よう}の〜 (~ for mountain climbing)

RELATED TERMS:
- {登山|とざん} (mountaineering - more formal)
- ハイキング (hiking - loanword)
- トレッキング (trekking)
- {山|やま} (mountain)

Japan has many popular mountains for climbing, including {富士山|ふじさん} (Mt. Fuji).
